_: The universe rules, avo's own (4 Nov 2026). Owned by avo; changed only by a pull request. The module that reads this file is rcdata/build/spine/my_universe.py; nothing else holds a copy of a number here.

stocks._: A security row of these tiers whose type is one of these. Tier A is listed on Nasdaq, NYSE or Cboe; Tier D has no exchange in the SEC file. royalty_trust, bdc and bank_nonsec are operating types the identity master knows and avo left out; an untyped name stays out until it is typed.

etfs._: An etf row that is no ETN and no CEF, with an AUM (etf.aum: shares times close, else N-CEN) at or over aum_floor_usd, or a 20-session average daily dollar volume at or over adv_usd_20d_floor. Either one is enough (avo, 18 Nov 2026).
etfs._exit: A fund already in the list leaves only when both present numbers are under these exit floors, 20 % under the entry floors (avo, 22 Nov 2026, SP6). A NULL number is left to the hold rules of my_universe.py.
